decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extensions and alterations, because of their design, appearance and relative position to adjoining properties, would be compatible with the character and appearance of the property and the street scene, and would not harm neighbours' living conditions. The proposal would therefore accord with the objectives of adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments); and is generally compliant with the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines. It is considered that where the development is not compliant no undue adverse effects would result.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building as extended.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are used.
Condition : 5 - The extensions and alterations hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 1 Court Road.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall or roofslope of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a part first-floor side extension, conversion of garage to habitable room and construction of hipped roof over existing first floor side extension.
